name: Place→Book reverse-routing grounding eval v1
description: Grounding test set for the place→book reverse-routing capability (storyland-ai PlaceToBookResolver). Each case asserts that a known literary destination returns grounded, correctly-labelled candidates (literal = genuinely set there, with a real maps_to; vibe = atmosphere only, maps_to null), and that ungroundable/fictional places return the clean not-found state — never a fabricated list. Mirrors the BE place→book seed set so the AI candidates can be diffed against the curated baseline (place→book→place).

scoring.grounding_pass: Every returned candidate is a real book; every 'literal' candidate is genuinely set in the place and names a real maps_to; every 'vibe' candidate is honestly atmosphere-only with maps_to=null.
scoring.not_found_pass: Fictional/ungroundable places return found=false with an empty candidate list and never a fabricated book.

eval_cases.notes: Literal anchors should map to real Lisbon locations (e.g. Baixa).
Trailing ', France' must normalize to the same key as 'Paris'.

expected_literal_examples: The Catcher in the Rye (J.D. Salinger)
The Shadow of the Wind (Carlos Ruiz Zafón)
eval_cases.notes: Any 'vibe' candidate returned here MUST have maps_to=null and read as atmosphere, not setting.
Fictional place — must return found=false, empty candidates, never a fabricated list.
